portal_description:
OVN, the Open Virtual Network, is a system to support virtual network abstraction.  OVN complements the existing capabilities of OVS to add native support for virtual network abstractions, such as virtual L2 and L3 overlays and security groups.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* selection fileds for OVN LBs and ECMP routes do not support IPv6 addresses (JIRA:FDP-1032)

* [OVN][BGP] Expose config to tweak whether distributed NAT IPs are advertised on all chassis. (JIRA:FDP-1464)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - BW limit not applied to VM with VLAN port whose compute's NIC has type=system (JIRA:FDP-1488)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - OVN routers cause exact match on IPv6 external addresses in OVS datapath (JIRA:FDP-1559)

* BGP: connected-as-host redistribution requires an LRP with an IP (JIRA:FDP-1563)

* bgp: connected-as-host redistributes nat entries too. (JIRA:FDP-1564)

* [OVN][BGP] ovn-controller should handle old kernels that don't support filtered route netlink dumps (JIRA:FDP-1613)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - Packet Loss Between VMs on DPDK Compute Nodes  - Issue Persists Despite All Recommendations of KCS(7076184) Applied (JIRA:FDP-1620)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - Static MAC binding "referential integrity violation" (JIRA:FDP-1639)

* OVN 25.03 FDP-ovn-25.8 RHEL 9 Release (JIRA:FDP-1669)

* Implement BGP route learning and advertisement in OVN (JIRA:FDP-711)

* Unexpected conditional SNAT (JIRA:FDP-787)
